name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for bathroom drywall repair?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for bathroom drywall repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor, look for experience specifically in bathroom and water damage repair, as this requires understanding moisture control. Verify they are licensed and insured in California. Ask for references and view examples of their previous work. A reputable contractor will provide a detailed, written estimate outlining the scope of work, materials, timeline, and cost. Communication and transparency are also key indicators of a reliable professional.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in water damage, verify their license and insurance, check references, and get a detailed written estimate.
